item.title: Winter Weather Postpones NASCAR's Clash at Bowman Gray Already Shortened Program to Wednesday
item.description: After first being moved to Monday, NASCAR's Clash was pushed further to Wednesday due to historic snowfall across North Carolina.

item.title: NASCAR Drivers Use Unexpected Snow Day to Have Winter Fun with Personal Trucks
item.description: With the Clash pushed until Wednesday, the likes of Chase Briscoe, Ryan Preece, and Chris Buescher all took their off Saturday, stuck in an unexpected 10 inches of North Carolina snowfall as an opportunity to push their trucks and promote their sponsors.

item.title: Rockingham Test for NASCAR O'Reilly and Truck Series Moved to Friday Amidst Winter Weather Scramble
item.description: Rockingham now joins The Clash as being shortened and moved back twice, with O'Reilly and Trucks' first test of the year at the track moved from Tuesday and Wednesday to a one-day program on Friday.
